page.overview:
Who is Harry Grimbridge?

Harry Grimbridge is a character who appears in .

Harry Grimbridge owned a mask store. One night, he was running to get away from a man in a suit. The man followed him but Harry killed him by pushing a car on top of him. He made it to a hospital and passed out on the floor. He was taken to a room and left there overnight. But another man in a suit followed him in there and put his hand over his mouth and killed him by pulling his skull apart and gouging out his eyes. The man then lit himself on fire in order to commit suicide.
